fact: Biometric Update quotes ANIP's Director General saying ANIP, attached to the presidency, is in charge of all identity matters in Benin.
ANIP says the single national identity database and the national civil status file are managed by one entity, the national agency ANIP.
ANIP's own deck presents the national agency as running the national register of physical persons and its online delivery and authentication of documents.
ANIP's service page says the biometric national identity card is issued in Benin by the national agency ANIP, on the basis of the holder's personal identification number.
